reason: The text fragment is a narrative passage describing Moses meeting the daughters of Jethro (the priest of Midian) at a well, their rescue from shepherds, and Moses subsequently marrying Zipporah. The passage contains no commentary on, reference to, or assessment of the state of the Hebrew people or the responsibility/blame of leaders for that state. It is a personal biographical account of Moses in exile in Midian and is completely disconnected from the thematic content of the statement.
